# Solution Sahab

> Solution Sahab designs, supplies and installs invisible grills, pleated mosquito mesh, honeycomb partitions, aluminium security mesh, weather screens, skylights and ceiling cloth hangers for homes, offices and institutions across Delhi NCR.

- Head office: 35, Kh.No.-7/8, Road No. 5, Shri Ram Colony, Nilothi Extn. Nangloi, New Delhi-110041
- Branch office: B-45 first floor, Indra Enclave, near IGNOU University, New Delhi - 110068
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 9971-143-143
- Email: solutionsahab@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Sunday, 09:00 to 20:00
- Areas served: Delhi, New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Greater Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/qWAbFe2HWvLwrDyLA

## Products

- [Invisible Grills](https://solutionsahab.com/invisible-grills): AISI 316 stainless steel cable grills for balconies and windows that keep children and pets safe without blocking the view; 5-year rust guarantee.
- [Pleated Mosquito Mesh](https://solutionsahab.com/pleated-mesh): retractable pleated mesh for balcony doors and windows with Jindal T6 aluminium frames; Prime Series, roller and barrier-free options.
- [Honeycomb Partition](https://solutionsahab.com/honeycomb-partition): honeycomb cellular partitions, acoustic blinds and 2-in-1 Duet mesh systems.
- [Aluminum Security Mesh](https://solutionsahab.com/aluminum-mesh-partition): heavy-duty, knife-shear resistant aluminium security mesh doors and partitions.
- [Automatic Weather Screen](https://solutionsahab.com/automatic-weather-screen): motorised zip screens and weather blinds for balconies and terraces.
- [Skylight](https://solutionsahab.com/skylight): laminated glass roof skylights and stairwell domes.
- [Ceiling Cloth Hanger](https://solutionsahab.com/ceiling-cloth-hanger): SS 304 ceiling-mounted cloth drying hangers with individual pipe control.
